decisions.reason: The IMU module sits squarely within the firm's sensor brick know-how, so it can interpret field feedback and refine it with its own R&D, though the shift to newer connectors may bring a successor version.
The industrial AC voltage input module draws on the firm's established power-measurement and energy-management expertise and supports its strategic direction, so it stays on the market.
The four-channel solid state relay is a close extension of existing relay peripherals that the firm fully understands and can maintain cheaply in-house.
The server room kit bundles well-known sensors and software, but as a packaged kit it is more exposed to consolidation, so its drop risk is moderate though below keeping it.
The RGB LED control module builds on the firm's LED and control expertise within the modular architecture, allowing it to learn from early results and improve it.
The wallbox remote access service leverages the firm's software and charging know-how and directly supports its expansion into networked energy management.
